egypt_courier_duty_pct_note: No official rate found. Laptops (HS 8471.30) 0% per secondary sources (hscodedb, GroWrk, FGX); SSD/RAM/GPU/monitors unknown. DHL official: duty ranges 0-60% by classification.
egypt_phone_import_charge_conflict: EnterpriseAM says 37.5; The National and Ahram say 38.5
dhl_egypt_duty_tax_processing: USD 5 or 2% of fiscal charge, whichever is higher; plus release to broker USD 13 (DTU shipments)
uae_tourist_refund_note: 85% of VAT less AED 4.80 per tag, min AED 250, tourists only, validate within 90 days
ksa_tourist_refund_note: 15% refund for non-resident tourists, min SAR 500, within 90 days
traveler_free_allowance_note: New goods for personal use EGP 15,000 per person (2023 amendment, EnterpriseAM); EntryBrief still says EGP 10,000; no 2026 official page found. Phones lost their free allowance 2026-01-21. No item-count rule for laptops/components found; trade quantities are refused.
